The bug has been fixed and verified.

### Cause of Bug
In [`ZipArchiveEntry`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/compress_13_group_c_fix/src/main/java/org/apache/commons/compress/archivers/zip/ZipArchiveEntry.java#L511), `setName(String name)` did not normalize backslashes (`\`) to forward slashes (`/`) for FAT platform entries without forward slashes, causing entry paths created on Windows systems (such as by WinZip) to retain backslashes.

### Solution
Updated [`setName(String name)`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/compress_13_group_c_fix/src/main/java/org/apache/commons/compress/archivers/zip/ZipArchiveEntry.java#L511-L518) in [`ZipArchiveEntry.java`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/compress_13_group_c_fix/src/main/java/org/apache/commons/compress/archivers/zip/ZipArchiveEntry.java) to replace backslashes with forward slashes when the platform is `PLATFORM_FAT` and no forward slash is present in the name.

The focused patch was generated and saved to [`negative_fix.patch`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/compress_13_group_c_fix/negative_fix.patch).

### Verification
Ran:
```bash
export TZ='America/Los_Angeles'; export _JAVA_OPTIONS='-Duser.language=en -Duser.country=US -Duser.timezone=America/Los_Angeles'; mvn test -Dtest=CucumberTest
```
All Cucumber scenarios in [`requirement.feature`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/compress_13_group_c_fix/requirement.feature) passed completely.
